q: Roughly what test error does the 56-layer network end at, and how does that compare with the 20-layer one?
gt: 56-layer ends near 13-14% test error; 20-layer near 10%; deeper is worse

q: What happens to the signal right after the addition in this diagram?
gt: a relu is applied after F(x)+x

q: What do the dotted shortcut arrows mean, and how many of them are in the 34-layer residual network?
gt: dotted shortcuts increase dimensions (projection/zero-pad when filters double); there are 3 in the 34-layer residual net

q: At about which iterations do the sudden drops in error happen, and why?
gt: around 15x10^4 and 30x10^4 iterations; learning rate divided by 10

q: In the right panel, what colour is the 1202-layer curve and roughly what test error does it reach?
In the bottom plot, which network has the smallest responses overall?
gt: ResNet-110 (black) lowest; ResNets lower than plain nets
